reported_status: P1 proposes restricted-port assembly of commercial capillary stock, universal retaining rails/clips and a custom micro-Y inside a closed host. Its introduced hydraulic and stock/schedule calculations support conditional screening of three layouts. The complete manufacturing/renewal operation, micro-Y and microgripper remain unqualified, and the required cost/turnaround advantage was not demonstrated.
